interface.scenario: UIREQ-023 scenario 2 (Midnight stagenet end-to-end qualification); scenario 1 keeps its --native-inventory interface
interface.record: committed JSON {format:'moriarty-sherlock-native-qualification/1', source:{path (committed draft .mori with a closed entry), sha256}, pins:{network:'stagenet', ledger_version:'9', node_version, toolchain, relation_id (sha256 of relation_vk_path bytes), relation_vk_path (committed Midnight 'midnight:verifier-key[vN]:' file of the called circuit), state_layout_path (committed compiled ledger layout), state_layout_sha256}, stages:{compile:{status}, prove:{status, prover}, verify:{status, verifier (not the prover)}, deploy:{status, tx (64-hex indexer hash of the ContractDeploy), address}, call:{status, tx, entry_point}, readback:{status, state_sha256 (sha256 of the indexed post-call state bytes), observed_result (optional; must equal the decoded value), effects: []}}, claims:{execution_authority:'none', preview_fenrir_evidence_transferred:false}}; every stage status is 'run' or 'not-run'
interface.holdout: recomputes the source, relation and layout hashes; requires all six stages run (else SPEC GATE); requires the deploy tx to be the indexed ContractDeploy of the address and the call tx a distinct indexed ContractCall there with the recorded entry point; requires the pinned verifying key body (after its 'midnight:verifier-key[vN]:' header) to occur exactly once in the deploy and post-call states, at most 64 bytes after the entry point name (relation installed for that entry); DECODES the result from the indexed state bytes through the committed layout: the deploy-state value must equal layout.initial, the post-call value must equal the holdout's own mori simulate reference result of the committed source, and the two must differ; the record's observed_result is never trusted
interface.evaluator_note: Evaluator-authored (sherlock-eval 2026-10-25). No wallet is opened by the holdout; an unreachable indexer is host-unfit (exit 3). Ledger 9, node, SDK and proof server stay unchanged. CONTRACT CHANGE 2026-10-26 (quint-3 finding via sherlock-fable): the readback result is now decoded from the indexed state, and the on-chain verifying key is bound to the pinned relation.
interface.state_layout: {format:'moriarty-sherlock-state-layout/1', result:{offset:int (byte offset into the indexed contract state), length:16, encoding:'u128-le'|'u128-be', initial:'<decimal value in the deploy state>'}}
